sensory_details_i_remember: I remember the faint smell of antiseptic wafting from the clinic, mixed with the sweet aroma of spilled chai from my cart
I noticed the flickering fluorescent lights above, casting an eerie glow on the anxious faces of students
I felt the tension in the air as students paced back and forth, their whispers and nervous laughter punctuated by the rustling of resumes
I recall the sound of clinking cups and muted conversations, a stark contrast to the usual chatter and laughter that fills my chai cart
